note: Stocks steadied today, and the VIX fear index eased to 25.6 after yesterday's jump. A strong jobs report nudged the 10-year Treasury yield up to 4.86%. Steady hiring supports rental demand for homes and apartments, but higher borrowing costs keep pressure on buyers and building owners.

vix.detail: Down from 28.2 the day before. Long-run average: about 19.5. The score uses the recent average (21.7), so one day moves it less.

credit.detail: Strong companies paid 0.89 points more than the government to borrow in October. Near the low end of the past 20 years.

mort.detail: A year ago: 6.22%. Down three weeks in a row from 7.40% in mid-October.

unemp.detail: San Francisco–Oakland 4.2%, San Jose 4.0% (seasonally adjusted). U.S.: 4.1% in October. Tech jobs down 2.2% from a year ago; all jobs up 0.8%.

supply.detail: Santa Clara County (Realtor.com): 2.3 homes for sale for every one under contract, 20% more listings than a year ago, 31% with a price cut.

hp.detail: Average of FHFA indexes for San Francisco–San Mateo, Oakland–Berkeley and San Jose. Oakland fell most, about 5% over the year.

valueF.detail: Home prices (FHFA) compared with rents: about 3% above normal.

t10.detail: Up from 4.84% the day before, after a strong jobs report.

sloos.detail: A net 15% of large banks eased their apartment-loan rules (Federal Reserve survey).

vacRel.detail: California rental vacancy (Census, 2025): 4.8%, about 0.3 points below its 2005–2025 average of 5.1%.

rentCPI.detail: Rent paid by all tenants in the San Francisco–Oakland area (consumer price index). Covers every lease, so it moves slowly.

pipe.detail: 27,609 homes approved in the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas over the past two years, about 17% below normal.

baa.detail: Riskier (Baa) companies paid 1.57 points more than the 10-year Treasury yield. Near the low end of the past 20 years.

ndx.detail: Closed at 26,629.81, 14.7% below its Oct 6 record of 31,224.47.

supplyP.detail: Santa Clara County single-family homes: 1.6 months of supply (MLS). Condos: 4.1 months. 31% of listings cut their price (Realtor.com, September).

cs.detail: Case-Shiller San Francisco index (seasonally adjusted). Prices fell for most of 2025 and are rising again.

value.detail: Case-Shiller prices compared with San Francisco-area rents: about 13% above normal. Rent covers less of a home's price than usual.

cap.detail: Average for San Francisco Bay Area apartment buildings (CoStar), up from 5.5% a year ago. Newer luxury buildings sell at about 4.25–4.65%.

vac.detail: San Francisco Bay Area apartments (CoStar). A year ago: 4.8%.

rent.detail: Average asking rent: $2,910 a month across the San Francisco Bay Area (CoStar).

ins.detail: U.S. consumer price index for tenants' and household insurance.

hpSJ.detail: FHFA index for the San Jose–Sunnyvale–Santa Clara area: down about 1% from a year ago.

valueSJ.detail: San Jose-area home prices (FHFA) compared with rents: about 9% above normal.
